name: Zenith 100% Wool
effects:
Causes ATK/MAG/DEF/RES -70% to all targets, grants Fire/Ice/Lightning Ability Damage +30% & Quick Cast to party, grants Ultimate Mode to user
Ultimate Spirit Mode: Black Magic/Dancer Casting Speed x1.1 & chases ally's Fire/Ice/Lightning abilities with Quick ATB 1 to that ally (max 3 chases)
Ultimate Dexterity Mode: Dualcast Black Magic/Dancer, Higher Multiplier & Zero Hone Cost to Hero Ability; Black Combo+: 1.2s CT; Sidekick+: 1.2s CT
Ultimate Vitality Mode: +1500 max HP & Astra to user
